title: Consolidate divergent state promotion paths
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-004). MemoryStateMachine.Evaluate() uses scoring thresholds for promotion, but PromoteStableRecords in MemoryMaintenanceTasks uses different criteria (30 days + 2 refs + 0.7 confidence). This creates inconsistent promotion decisions. Also includes index not updating during consolidation (P1-005) where DeduplicateRecords, PromoteStableRecords, DeprecateObsoleteRecords modify records and save to store but never update MemoryIndex.

Files: MemorySmith.Core/StateMachine/MemoryStateMachine.cs, MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryMaintenanceTasks.cs
Confidence: 100%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
